advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test seeding a `<40-hex>`-tagged orphan candidate that is still referenced by a running container, asserting reconcile logs 'not removed (still referenced...)' and issues no successful removal.
evidence: Added source: `if docker image rm "$ref" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ... else log "mcp reconcile: orphan $ref not removed (still referenced, or already gone) — non-fatal"`
The docker stub models refusal: `if [ "$(refcount "$3")" -gt 0 ]; then echo "image-rm-refused $3" >> "$LOG"; exit 1; fi` (tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py:73)

Violating input: a `compose-mcp:<40-hex>` tag matching guard-1 (a true `<sha>` candidate that is neither live nor prev) while a running container references that image — reconcile attempts `image rm`, the daemon refuses, and the non-fatal branch must fire; no test seeds this combination (all orphans are seeded with `containers` emptied).
Added source: `[ "${#prev_sha}" -eq 40 ] || { log "mcp reconcile: recorded previous sha malformed; deferring orphan sweep"; return 0; }`
The case pattern `*[!0-9a-f]*|""` only catches non-hex/empty; a purely-hex short string (e.g. `abc`) passes it and is caught ONLY by the length guard.
Violating input: seed `mcp-previous-sha` with `"abc"` (all-hex, length 3) — reconcile must log 'recorded previous sha malformed' and defer; no test writes a short-hex marker.
advisory.finding: The reconcile guard-4 backstop — `docker image rm` WITHOUT -f, relying on the daemon refusing to remove a still-referenced image — has no test. All orphan tests seed container-less tags; none seeds a `<sha>` tag that IS still referenced by a running container to prove reconcile logs the 'still referenced' non-fatal branch and does NOT count it removed.
merged_from: The reconcile deferral on a MALFORMED-LENGTH recorded previous sha (hex but not 40 chars) is untested. `test_reconcile_defers_when_no_previous_release_recorded` covers only the absent/empty marker; the added `[ "${#prev_sha}" -eq 40 ]` guard with its distinct 'recorded previous sha malformed' log line has no test.
scenarios: An orphan-shaped tag whose container is still running is (wrongly) counted as reconciled or the refusal backstop regresses.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a cutover test where the outgoing mcp-deployed-sha equals _TARGET and assert mcp-previous-sha is not written to the target sha.
evidence: Violating input: seed `mcp-deployed-sha` equal to `_TARGET` and drive a deploy; the guard must suppress recording so mcp-previous-sha is not written to _TARGET. No test seeds mcp-deployed-sha == _TARGET at cutover.
Also the empty/first-deploy branch `*[!0-9a-f]*|""` (no outgoing sha recorded) is only implicitly hit and not asserted (mcp-previous-sha must remain absent).
advisory.finding: The cutover's same-sha guard `[ "$mcp_deployed" != "$TARGET" ]` is untested. `test_cutover_records_the_outgoing_release_as_previous` uses a distinct outgoing sha; no test exercises a redeploy where the outgoing live sha equals the target, which must NOT record a previous marker (else live==prev and reconcile preserves only one image).
scenarios: A no-change re-tag or the != TARGET guard regressing would record live==prev, collapsing the two preserved images to one and defeating rollback preservation.
